en: Black‑and‑white view of a neo‑Gothic church with two tall, ornate spires rising above dense trees and rooftops. In the foreground are terraced stone walls covered with vegetation, a tiled roof, and lampposts along a path. The photo is vertically framed and appears to be an early 20th‑century postcard photograph of a European cathedral or large church seen from a lower garden or vineyard area. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
